english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person or event that turns out fortunately.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice, especially when someone narrowly avoids a bad outcome.
Use this when happy means lucky or fortunate.

examples.english: I was lucky to catch the last train.
examples.jyutping: hou2 coi2 ngo5 gon2 dak1 cit3 mei5 baan1 ce1

examples.english: I was fortunate to catch the train.
examples.jyutping: hou2 coi2 ngo5 gon2 dak1 cit3 baan1 ce1

examples.english: I'm happy we were lucky—you reminded me; otherwise we'd have been in trouble.
examples.traditional: 好彩你提醒我，唔係就大鑊喇。
examples.jyutping: hou2 coi2 nei5 tai4 sing2 ngo5 m4 hai6 zau6 daai6 wok6 laa3
